Line.zh:
He looks at his wares, then at you.

You understand: the more he trusts you, the better the things he'll offer.

He sniffs at them, then looks at you again.

He likes bugs, mice, all kinds of acorns, and edible roots.

name.zh:
A large, curiously aware badger peeks out of the mysterious burrow.

He pushes some of his belongings outside, keeping them within reach of his claws.

He looks at you. He seems willing to trade.
